title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 04:39:56 最新章节：第518章 萧国主好久不见
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
大雪飘零而下，温郗（X）死了。
她在洁白的病床上缓缓闭上眼睛，结束了十八岁的生命。
下一瞬，混乱的吵闹声涌进了她的耳中——
“就是她！神皿选中了她！”
“快让她献出心头血！”
温郗缓缓睁眼，有一瞬的晕眩感袭来，缓了一会后才发现自己正站在一间古色古香的宽阔正厅中。
她微微睁大了眼睛，自己不是死了吗？
谁救活了她？
可还有谁能救活她？
温郗眉头微蹙，不动声色地打量了一下周围——
雕梁画栋，但摆设古朴陈旧。
她的正前方是一个发着绿光的长条状不明物体，看着像根树枝，她手里则是捧着一个同样发光的盛具，只不过光芒很微弱。
温郗约莫数了一下，大厅的边缘和角落里站着二十四个人。他们都穿着统一的棕色长袍，配有金线交织，衣着古典，气势非凡。
此刻，他们正虎视眈眈地盯着她。
或者说，盯着她手里的“碗”。
温希不了解情况，但敏锐地察觉到了这些人没多少善意。
就在这时，她脑海中响起一道机械音——
【欢迎宿主来到修仙界启明洲。】
【当前为天启国元武十四年，即启明洲历一万零三十二年，为您生成的身份是天启国昭舒公主，萧温郗，骨龄十四。】
【现检测到宿主生命受到直接威胁，发布新手福利任务，避开此日献祭，奖励为灵根觉醒，失败无惩罚。】

一位女子沉声道：“来人，准备布阵献祭。”
温郗刚刚消化完机械音里的信息就听见这句话，气到想笑——
献祭？
开局就死？
还失败无惩罚？
笑死，当然不用有惩罚，因为她人会直接嘎掉。
这时，一位少年踏入了正厅，他身穿一身浅绿色道袍，看着不过十四五岁。厅内所有人的目光瞬间聚焦在了他的身上。
那少年只略微低头扫了一眼温郗手中的碗，语气冰冷：“反应很微弱。”
他在不满。
一个男人叹了口气：“可没办法，少主，她是目前唯一能让神皿产生共鸣的。”
少年皱眉，刚要开口，又有一人惊慌失措地冲进来：“少主，不好了，祠堂内前任家主的命魂果消散了。”
众人哗然，有人用眼神识海交流，有人则是小声说着什么。
少年脸色一变，抬脚就要离开，那中年男人紧急开口：“那公主的事——”
温郗立刻抓住机会：“既然神皿不满意我，强取恐怕徒劳无功，甚至可能损坏此物。倒不如改日再试，或许还有转机。”
“反正今日不合适，不是吗？”
温郗有些紧张地等待结果，希望可以暂时拖一拖——那东西只说躲过今日献祭，又没说别的，先活过今天再说。
空灵如琉璃般的嗓音响起，瞬间压下所有声音，让大厅陷入一片寂静。
那些人若有所思地看着温郗，神色复杂。
绿衣少年沉吟了片刻，开口时语气依旧没什么波动：“来人，带她回客房。”
话音未落，立刻有一位长相甜美的侍女从屋外出现，她垂首领着温郗来到了一处偏僻没人的院落。
content_en:
Heavy snow fell, and Wen Xi (X) died.
She slowly closed her eyes on the white hospital bed and ended her eighteen-year-old life.
The next moment, chaotic noises flooded into her ears——
"It's her! The God's dish chose her!"
"Let her donate her heart's blood!"
Wen Xi slowly opened his eyes, feeling dizzy for a moment. After a while, he realized that he was standing in an ancient and spacious main hall.
She opened her eyes slightly, wasn't she dead?
Who saved her?
But who else can save her?
Wen Xi frowned slightly and looked around calmly——
There are carved beams and painted buildings, but the furnishings are simple and outdated.
Directly in front of her was a long, unknown object that glowed green, looking like a branch. In her hand, she held a container that also glowed, but the light was very weak.
Wen Xi counted about twenty-four people standing on the edge and corners of the hall. They all wore uniform brown robes with intertwined gold threads, classical clothes and extraordinary momentum.
At this moment, they were staring at her eagerly.
In other words, staring at the "bowl" in her hand.
Wen hope didn't understand the situation, but he was keenly aware that these people didn't have much good intentions.
At this moment, a mechanical sound sounded in her mind——
[Welcome the host to Qimingzhou, the world of immortality. 】
[The current year is the fourteenth year of Yuanwu of the Apocalypse Kingdom, which is the 1032nd year of the Qiming continent calendar. The identity generated for you is Princess Zhaoshu of the Apocalypse Kingdom, Xiao Wenxi, with a bone age of fourteen. 】
[It is now detected that the host's life is under direct threat, and a newbie welfare task is released to avoid the sacrifice on this day. The reward is spiritual root awakening, and there is no penalty for failure. 】
A woman said in a deep voice: "Come here, prepare to form a formation to sacrifice."
Wen Xi had just finished digesting the information in the mechanical voice when he heard this sentence and was so angry that he wanted to laugh——
Sacrifice?
Die at the start?
No punishment for failure?
Of course there is no punishment for laughing to death, because she will be killed immediately.
At this time, a young man stepped into the main hall. He was wearing a light green robe and looked to be no more than fourteen or fifteen years old. The eyes of everyone in the hall instantly focused on him.
The young man only slightly lowered his head and glanced at the bowl in Wen Xi's hand, and said in a cold tone: "The reaction is very weak."
He is dissatisfied.
A man sighed: "There is no way, young master, she is the only one who can resonate with the divine vessel at present."
The young man frowned and was about to speak when another person rushed in in panic: "Young Master, it's not good. The Life Soul Fruit of the previous head of the family in the ancestral hall has disappeared."
Everyone was in an uproar. Some people communicated with their eyes, while others whispered something.
The young man's expression changed and he raised his feet to leave. The middle-aged man said urgently: "The matter about the princess——"
Wen Xi immediately seized the opportunity: "Since the divine dish is dissatisfied with me, I'm afraid it will be futile to take it by force, and it may even damage it. It's better to try again another day, maybe there will be a turn for the better."
"It's not a good day anyway, isn't it?"
Wen Xi waited nervously for the result, hoping that it could be postponed for a while - the thing only said that he would avoid today's sacrifice, but didn't say anything else. He should survive today first.
A voice as ethereal as glass sounded, instantly suppressing all sounds and plunging the hall into silence.
Those people looked at Wen Xi thoughtfully, with complicated expressions.
The young man in green pondered for a moment, and his tone remained calm when he spoke: "Come, take her back to the guest room."
Before he finished speaking, a sweet-looking maid appeared from outside the house. She lowered her head and led Wen Xi to a remote and deserted courtyard.
